serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services) for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes set aside per bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative load from that bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity, not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured rather than a ceiling of zero
